d: Vago garden with spacious stairway for which it ascends to the palace of Podestà. The Podestà, the knight Ramiro and Serpetta that descends from the stairway; Sandrina and Nardo applied to the garden culture.
The Podestà, Sandrina, Serpetta and Nardo.
Gallery. The Podestà, Arminda, then Serpetta.
Snake, then Nardo with basket of fruits.
The Podestà, then Serpetta and Nardo.
Sandrina and the Continum, then the Podestà, Serpetta and Nardo for observation on one side; Arminda and Ramiro on the other.
Atrium of the palace of the Podestà. Ramiro and Arminda.
Sandrina, then the Continum, finally the Podestà in observation.
The Podestà, then Arminda, then Ramiro with paper.
Hall. The Podestà, Arminda, Serpetta, and the Continent.
Nardo, then Podestà and Ramiro, then Serpetta.

Desert place, and alpine pastures of ancient aqueducts in part ruined among which there is a practicable dark cave. Sandrina fearful, and trembling, in the act that you see rushingly flee several Persons, who have left it there.
The Continum and Nardo, lean on each other for the arm, and said, then Arminda, then Podestà and Serpetta, finally Ramiro.
Nardo, then the Continum, then Sandrina.
The Podestà, then Arminda and Ramiro from various parts.
Garden. Sandrina and the Continum sleeping, one on one side, and one on the other, which to the sound of sweet symphony are waking up.
The Podestà, Arminda, Ramiro and Serpetta, then Nardo, finally Sandrina and Contino.
